messages:
maya: Quick sync — pricing/packaging implementation triage. Three open dependency questions blocking ship: metering schema change, quota enforcement rollout, and contract prorate behavior. Can owners call out ETA and risks? 

ajay: I can own the metering schema work. I glanced at https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 — needs fixture updates and a consumers checklist. Aiming to land review by EOD. :+1:

liz: Quota enforcement (eng-runtime) is the gating item for dedicated customers. Derek, is the quota_v2 flag still on track for the runtime patch today?

derek: yes runtime 2.8 will include quota_v2 behind flag. Landing in canary this afternoon. Risk: if we flip it on too soon, some legacy quota rules in billing-adapter will reject requests.

maya: Good to know. Contract team: we still need clear rule for prorating when plan tiers change mid-billing-cycle — product needs deterministic rule for billing adapter. @sam-contracts can you confirm?

sam-contracts: Prefer deterministic rounding down for legacy contracts unless customer has explicit prorate opt-in. For new contracts we can support prorate up to cents. Will drop a short policy here.

sam-contracts: policy snippet: `if contract.version == "v1" then prorate_amount = 0 else prorate_amount = round_to_cents(days_used / days_in_period * price)`

ajay: That policy implies metering events must include `contract_version` and optional `prorate_hint`. I need an agreed field list to avoid multiple schema rounds.

metering-bot: FYI: schema change (add fields: contract_version, prorate_hint) will break ingestion for `metering-ingest` v1 consumers. Recommend dual-write for 90 days.

liz: Dual-write seems safest. Derek / ops: can runtime support both shapes without perf hit?

derek: yes — we can accept both payloads. Slight CPU bump for validation (~1-2%), should be fine behind a config flag.

ops-runner: If we do dual-write, we need a rollout plan in Console: feature flag, preview toggle for a small set of customers, and a metrics dashboard (error rate, 95th latency). I can project the dashboards but need the exact metric names.

maya: Action items: 
- ajay: PR + fixture updates for metering schema (owner) — ETA EOD today.
- derek: land runtime quota_v2 behind flag and expose toggle in console — ETA end of day.
- sam-contracts: finalize contract policy text and signoff (small doc) — ETA tomorrow morning.
- ops-runner: prep dashboards and rollout playbook (needs metric names from ajay/derek) — ETA tomorrow.

ajay: I'll add `contract_version` (string) and `prorate_hint` (enum: none|auto|force) to the event schema and post a schema diff in the PR.

liz: I added a checklist item in the packaging tracker for QA: verify quotas for multi-plan orgs after dual-write.

maya: Thanks. Small ask: if any owner thinks ETA slips > 24h, call it out here so we can decide canary customers.

ajay: pinging @derek for a quick review after runtime lands; I may need a tiny adapter change to emit both fields.

derek: will review within 2h of landing.

ajay: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 (schema diff + test plan)

sam-contracts: Uploaded short policy doc to Confluence: /policies/proration-pricing-v1-v2 — link in PR comments.

metering-bot: Note: Deprecation window proposed: dual-write until epoch 3390000000 (approx 90 days).

maya: Great — let's reconvene async. If nothing changes by tomorrow 1100 PT I'll trigger canary list selection. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
